interpretation.isolated_stage: GET /categories/options?pagetitle=<validated exact category> or its response adapter
interpretation.note: The exact-leaf check confirms the taxonomy can be read, and the search check confirms /products can be queried. The optional taxonomy check then calls discover_category for that validated exact title without a model key and fails. This isolates the failing stage, but the sanitized response does not distinguish a 5xx HTTP reply from an unusable /categories/options payload. The earlier customer breaker turn emitted transport_5xx twice; only server-side tool logs can prove its exact upstream status and route.
